params.prompt: Korean webtoon / instatoon 2D illustration style for a mobile app ad, square 1:1: clean bold dark outlines, flat cel shading with soft gradients, bright saturated colors, expressive cute cartoon. NOT 3D. STRICT COMPOSITION: all characters and objects are in the LOWER part: their top edge below 36% of the image height, bottom around 86%. Upper 34% only background. No money, no coins, no logos. Draw the mascot from the reference image as a 2D webtoon character (Meri: big round fluffy orange petal-shaped hair, round peach face with rosy cheeks, red sweater with white letter M). No text or letters anywhere. Scene: a big cartoon balance scale. On the left pan, which is pushed DOWN, stand three cheerful plain round-headed white cartoon friends holding big blue shields; on the right pan, which is lifted UP high, Meri stands alone holding one tiny red shield, looking down at the heavier side with a worried pouty face and sweat drop; a red notification badge with a question mark symbol above Meri. Background: 2D illustrated warm coral to peach gradient with soft light rays, small sparkles and simple doodle shapes, no rain.
